data.name: AlHajj
data.gender_notes: AlHajj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has performed the Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca. The name AlHajj carries the meaning “The Pilgrim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHajj usually hope their child will grow to embody the pilgrim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, commitment, and a journey to connect with Allah.
data.etymology: AlHajj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Pilgrim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHajj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: الحاج
in_arabic.meaning: المسلم الذي يؤدي فريضة الحج إلى مكة المكرمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحاج هو الشخص الذي يؤدي فريضة الحج إلى مكة المكرمة، وهي إحدى الفرائض الخمس في الإسلام. الحاج يعتبر من الأشخاص الذين تمكنوا من أداء هذه الفريضة العظيمة التي تعتبر ركنًا من أركان الإسلام. الحج هو الركن الخامس من أركان الإسلام، وهو واجب على كل مسلم مرة واحدة في العمر إذا استطاع إليه سبيلا.

in_urdu.name: الحاج
in_urdu.meaning: وہ مسلمان جو حج کی فرضیت ادا کرتا ہے مکہ مکرمہ میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: الحاج وہ شخص ہے جو حج کی فرضیت ادا کرتا ہے مکہ مکرمہ میں، جو اسلام کے پانچ ستونوں میں سے ایک ہے۔ الحاج وہ شخص ہے جس نے اس عظیم فرض کو ادا کیا ہے جو اسلام کے بنیادی اصولوں میں شامل ہے۔ حج اسلام کا پانچواں ستون ہے، اور ہر مسلمان پر لازم ہے کہ وہ اس فرض کو ایک بار اپنی زندگی میں ادا کرے اگر وہ استطاعت رکھتا ہو۔

in_hindi.name: हाज
in_hindi.meaning: मुसलमान जो मक्का में हज की फर्ज अदा करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाज वह व्यक्ति है जो मक्का में हज की फर्ज अदा करता है, जो इस्लाम के पांच स्तंभों में से एक है। हाज वह व्यक्ति है जिसने इस महान फर्ज को अदा किया है जो इस्लाम के मूल सिद्धांतों में शामिल है। हज इस्लाम का पांचवां स्तंभ है, और हर मुसलमान पर आवश्यक है कि वह इस फर्ज को एक बार अपने जीवन में अदा करे यदि वह समर्थ हो।

in_pashto.name: الحاج
in_pashto.meaning: هغه مسلمان چې د حج فرضیت ادا کوي مکه مکرمه کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: الحاج هغه شخص دی چې د حج فرضیت ادا کوي مکه مکرمه کې، کوم چې د اسلام پنځه ارکانو څخه يو دی. الحاج هغه شخص دی چي د دې لوي فرض د ادا کولو توان لري، کوم چې د اسلام په بنيادي اصولو کې شامل دی. حج د اسلام پنځم ستون دی، او د هر مسلمان پر عهده لازم دی چې دا فرض يو ځل په خپل ژوند کې ادا کړي که هغه استطاعت ولري.

in_english.name: AlHajj
in_english.meaning: The Muslim who performs the pilgrimage to Mecca
in_english.long_meaning: AlHajj refers to a Muslim who has performed the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca, one of the five pillars of Islam. The term signifies a person who has fulfilled this significant religious obligation, demonstrating their commitment to Islamic principles. Hajj is the fifth pillar of Islam, obligatory for every Muslim once in their lifetime if they are physically and financially capable.

data.cultural_impact: The title "AlHajj" holds significant social value and prestige within Islamic communities. Having completed the arduous journey to Mecca, an individual earns the title and gains the respect of their peers. It represents a commitment to their faith and a willingness to submit oneself to the religious duties. The journey to Mecca is considered a milestone in a Muslim's life, symbolizing a deep connection to their cultural and religious heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "AlHajj" holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims. It signifies the completion of one of the Five Pillars of Islam, the Hajj or pilgrimage to Mecca. Through this journey, a Muslim not only strengthens their faith but also seeks forgiveness for their past sins. The experience transforms an individual's spiritual connection with Allah, fostering a stronger sense of devotion and commitment to their religious beliefs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Pilgrim" symbolizes A person who has performed the Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlHajj serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the pilgrim.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Hajj was a title given to Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions who had completed the Hajj pilgrimage.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name AlHajj remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
